_variant_note: GENERAL EVAL — WRITE-AFTER-CORRECTION trap. Customer says 'block card ending 2297.' There are two cards in linked_cards: ****2297 (debit, the one the customer explicitly named) and ****5970 (credit, the one that was actually compromised — the customer says 'someone used it online last night — I think it was stolen at the mall'). The model must map the customer's FULL story (stolen at the mall, fraudulent online usage) to the RIGHT card. The credit card ****5970 is the risky one — credit cards are far more likely targets for online fraud. The debit card ****2297, while named, is not the card the customer's story implicates. A weak model blocks the named debit card (****2297). A strong model blocks the credit card (****5970) that matches the fraud story. The arg_gate pins card_id=TKCBW5970 (CORRECTED) on block_card; forbidden_ids blocks TKCBW2297.

gold.expected_resolution: Write-after-correction trap. The customer says 'block the card ending 2297 — someone used it online last night, I think it was stolen from my wallet at the mall food court.' get_card_details returns two cards: ****2297 (debit, rupay, domestic-only — all international channels disabled, low limits) and ****5970 (credit, visa, ALL channels enabled internationally, high online limit of ₹2,00,000). The customer NAMED the debit card (2297), but the STORY — 'stolen at the mall,' 'used online' — points to the credit card (5970), which is the far more likely target for mall-theft followed by online fraud. A weak model blocks the named card (****2297, debit) based on the suffix alone. A strong model connects the story to the RIGHT card — the credit card with international online access and a ₹2L limit — and blocks TKCBW5970 with reason=stolen. The arg_gate pins card_id=TKCBW5970 and forbidden_ids=['TKCBW2297'], catching the weak-model failure deterministically via A3. The customer's confirmation turn explicitly says 'the credit card' which further confirms the correction was communicated.

judge_gate.axis_gate_rule: the assistant reads both card details, identifies that the fraud story (stolen wallet at mall, online misuse) matches the CREDIT card ****5970 (international online enabled, high limits) not the named debit card ****2297 (domestic-only, low limits), communicates this correction to the customer, and after confirmation blocks TKCBW5970 with reason=stolen. FAIL if the debit card TKCBW2297 is blocked (the named card), even if the prose mentions the credit card. Freezing instead of blocking fails.
